verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat can explain concepts and agent mode can explore/plan across a workspace, and docs mention creating a 'shared source of truth' from repos/docs for team context, which supports getting oriented in a codebase. However there's no dedicated feature (e.g., repo map, architecture diagram, codebase Q&A) explicitly documented for onboarding/navigation, and community evidence is silent on this specific use case. Missing for 10: dedicated codebase-navigation/architecture-overview feature, independent hands-on evidence of using Copilot to onboard into an unfamiliar large codebase.
